card.name: Inside esthesia and esthetic words
card.fires_on: The piece of a word just before the "esth" ending, as in aesthetic, anesthetic and dysesthesia. It responds at the break after "A", "AN", "aest" or "dy".

modes.description: The break inside anesthetic or dysesthesia, just before "sthesia" or "hetic".

card.writes: It pushes the model toward finishing the word with an "est" piece, as in esthetic or esthesia.
card.plain: It fires partway through words like anesthetic, aesthetic and dysesthesia, when the next piece is "est" or "sth".
